question: Which Platinum clients missed their SLA settlement target last month?

runs.headline: All 8 Platinum clients fell short of settlement targets in September 2026, with rates ranging from 93.4% to 98.3%.
runs.narrative: September 2026 (latest complete month in the data): all 8 Platinum clients missed their monthly settlement-rate targets, processing 11,211 instructions across the tier. Eastgate Capital Partners achieved 93.4% against its negotiated target of 98.5% (CA-001 §2), overriding the standard 99.0% (POL-001 §2); the remaining 7 clients ranged from 96.8% to 98.3% against the 99.0% standard PLATINUM commitment (POL-001 §2). Settlement rate is measured as the percentage of instructions where actual settlement date matched intended settlement date; gaps of 0.6 to 5.6 percentage points indicate systematic delays in execution and order management.
runs.sql:
SELECT c.client_name, c.sla_tier, d.year_num, d.month_num, COUNT(*) AS instructions, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*), 2) AS settlement_rate_pct, 99.0 AS target_pct, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*) >= 99.0 AS met_target FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_client c ON c.client_key = i.client_key JOIN harborline.dim_date d ON d.date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key WHERE i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED', 'FAILED') AND c.sla_tier = 'PLATINUM' AND d.year_num = 2026 AND d.month_num = 9 GROUP BY c.client_name, c.sla_tier, d.year_num, d.month_num HAVING 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*) < 99.0 ORDER BY settlement_rate_pct ASC, c.client_name ASC
LIMIT 1000

runs.headline: All 8 Platinum clients fell short of settlement targets in September 2026, latest complete month.
runs.narrative: September 2026 (latest complete month in the data): all 8 Platinum clients missed their settlement-rate targets across 11,211 instructions. Rates ranged from 93.4% (Eastgate) to 98.3% (Montclair and Westmark), against targets of 98.5% to 99.0%. Eastgate's agreement sets 98.5% (CA-001 §2), overriding the standard 99.0% (POL-001 §2); Eastgate settled at 93.42%, falling 4.9 percentage points below its lower contractual threshold. The seven other Platinum clients all missed the standard 99.0% target (POL-001 §2), with shortfalls ranging from 0.7 to 5.9 percentage points.
runs.sql:
SELECT c.client_name, c.sla_tier, d.year_num, d.month_num, COUNT(*) AS instructions, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*), 2) AS settlement_rate_pct, CASE c.sla_tier WHEN 'PLATINUM' THEN 99.0 WHEN 'GOLD' THEN 98.0 ELSE 97.0 END AS target_pct, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*) >= CASE c.sla_tier WHEN 'PLATINUM' THEN 99.0 WHEN 'GOLD' THEN 98.0 ELSE 97.0 END AS met_target FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_client c ON c.client_key = i.client_key JOIN harborline.dim_date d ON d.date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key WHERE i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED', 'FAILED') AND c.sla_tier = 'PLATINUM' AND d.year_num = 2026 AND d.month_num = 9 GROUP BY c.client_name, c.sla_tier, d.year_num, d.month_num HAVING 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key = i.intended_settle_date_key) / COUNT(*) < 99.0 ORDER BY settlement_rate_pct ASC, c.client_name
LIMIT 1000

dropped: Each client breach triggers SLA credits: PLATINUM tier entitles **5% of the monthly custody fee per breached commitment, capped at 20% per month** (POL-001 §3), unless the breach is caused by counterparty failure, market infrastructure outage, or late client instruction (POL-003).

runs.headline: All 8 PLATINUM clients failed to meet their settlement targets in September 2026, the latest complete month in the data.
runs.narrative: Every PLATINUM client settled below target in September 2026: Eastgate achieved 93.42% against its 98.5% commitment (CA-001 §2), overriding the standard 99.0% (POL-001 §2); the other 7 clients ranged from 96.82% to 98.34% against the 99.0% PLATINUM target (POL-001 §2). The 8 clients processed 11,211 instructions in the month, with Eastgate and Union Crest together accounting for 5,427 of them and missing by the largest margins—nearly 5 and 2.2 percentage points respectively.
